subject: VIP workshop — venue gear rider, comms routing, and backup plan
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Grand Plaza Hotel Ops <ops@grandplazahotel.com>, Sarah Cole <sarah@vertexanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VIP workshop — venue gear rider, comms routing, and backup plan

Hi Sarah / Grand Plaza Ops team,

Thanks again for hosting Vertex's executive workshop on 4/22. We need to lock the AV/comm stack and venue backline for the VIP roundtable and our all-hands in the main ballroom. Attached is our latest gear rider (VIP_Workshop_Gear_Rider_v2.pdf) and a quick stage plot (stage_plot_vip.png).

Top asks:
- Confirm inventory: check availability of Shure ULX-D (4x handheld mics + 6x lavs), two lecterns with XLR DI, and Dante-enabled mixing desk.
- Network: provide an isolated VLAN for conference devices (10 devices), and an L3 path for the Redwood meeting bridge (we will provide IPs).
- Redundancy: specify backup audio snake and second internet uplink (cellular failover or dedicated backup ISP).
- Comm routing: we need a mirrored stream to the guest overflow room and a separate feed for the client-facing broadcast team.

Action: please confirm availability and send a point estimate for the on-site tech labor (lead tech + 2 stagehands) and any additional rack/patch fees by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize the SOW.

Attachments: VIP_Workshop_Gear_Rider_v2.pdf; stage_plot_vip.png; main_room_floorplan.pdf (for reference).

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Program Lead, Customer Events
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Grand Plaza Hotel Ops <ops@grandplazahotel.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Sarah Cole <sarah@vertexanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VIP workshop — venue gear rider, comms routing, and backup plan

Hi Tessa / Sarah,

Thanks for the rider and diagrams — we can cover most of this in-house. Quick summary:
- Audio: We have Shure ULX-D inventory to cover 4 handhelds and 6 lavs. In case of failure, we keep a spare Sennheiser rack (2 handheld + 4 lavs).
- Mixing desk: Yamaha CL5 (Dante) available; we can patch dual outputs (main + broadcast) and dedicate a submix for overflow room.
- Network: We can create the isolated VLAN and reserve a /29 for conference gear. Our on-site firewall will allow the specific outbound IPs you provide.
- Redundancy: We can provide a bonded cellular failover rack (Cradlepoint) + secondary ISP on request (additional $350/day).
- Labor estimate (lead tech + 2 stagehands): $1,150 for 8 hours. Additional rack/patch fees: $200.

Open items:
1) Please confirm the exact public IPs and port ranges the Redwood meeting bridge will use.
2) Do you require AES67 or raw Dante multichannel routing to the broadcast booth?
3) Will Vertex's broadcast vendor bring an encoder — if so, provide the RTMP/SRT destination.

We can sign the SOW once these items are confirmed. I attached a short venue AV checklist PDF for Ops.

Best,
Marta Reyes (for Grand Plaza Ops)
Venue Technical Manager
Grand Plaza Hotel
ops@grandplazahotel.com

Attachments: venue_ops_quickcheck.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: VIP workshop — venue gear rider, comms routing, and backup plan

Looping internal ops — a few notes from my side after reviewing Marta's reply:
- Good: CL5 + Dante gives us the routing we need. Ask for a patch sheet that shows channel mapping between stage inputs and Dante channels (we'll need that for our stage manager).
- Network: Vivek — confirm whether the /29 is sufficient or if our devices need static IPs on a different range. We prefer static assignment for the meeting bridge.
- Redundancy: Markus — confirm we have a Redwood spare encoder (SRT-capable) that can be shipped or brought as an on-site backup. If not, budget to rent a pair.

Small ask for the event day run: can Hannah pick up the Grand Plaza onsite tech at 07:00 for the VIP setup?

Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Head of Events Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Grand Plaza Hotel Ops <ops@grandplazahotel.com>, Sarah Cole <sarah@vertexanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-17T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VIP workshop — venue gear rider, comms routing, and backup plan

Thanks Marta / team — this is helpful. Consolidated responses + asks below so we have a single checklist to close:

Confirmed (from Grand Plaza):
- Shure ULX-D primary + Sennheiser spare set.
- Yamaha CL5 (Dante) + dual outputs for main/broadcast.
- Venue can create isolated VLAN and reserve /29.
- Cellular failover available ($350/day) and secondary ISP option.
- Labor estimate: $1,150 (lead + 2 stagehands) + $200 rack/patch.

Requests from Redwood:
- Networking: Vivek to send public IPs and port ranges by 4/18 12:00 PT. If we need static IPs for the Redwood bridge devices, please reserve them on the VLAN.
- Audio patching: Marta please attach a channel patch sheet and confirm where the Dante stage boxes (if used) will be racked.
- Redundancy gear: Markus to confirm availability of Red encoder (SRT) by EOD 4/18; if unavailable, we will rent — authorizing up to $700 for rental.
- Onsite logistics: Hannah to coordinate pickup/meet at 07:00 on 4/22 and confirm staging time (we plan load-in at 06:30).

Attached: consolidated checklist (we've also updated the gear rider PDF to mark the confirmed items).

Next steps / deadlines:
- Grand Plaza: send patch sheet + confirm VLAN details by 4/18 12:00 PT.
- Vivek: IPs + port list by 4/18 12:00 PT.
- Markus: confirm backup encoder availability by 4/18 EOD.

Thanks — appreciate quick turnaround on the network items.

Tessa
--
Tessa Morgan
Program Lead, Customer Events
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: VIP workshop — venue gear rider, comms routing, and backup plan

Hi Tessa / team,

All good — see answers and attached patch sheet + signed rider.
- VLAN: reserved and configured; assigned range 198.51.100.8/29. We will hold static IPs .9-.14 for your devices. Please confirm final device MACs if you want DHCP reservations.
- Patch sheet: attached (stage_patch_sheet.pdf). Dante channels 1-16 map to stage mic inputs; FOH and Broadcast outputs on Dante channels 101-102.
- Encoder: we have an on-site backup encoder (Haivision Makito X) available for emergency; no rental required.
- Cellular: bonded failover rack will be staged at FOH; secondary ISP standby.
- Labor: invoice will be sent after event based on hours.

Attachments: stage_patch_sheet.pdf; signed_VIP_Workshop_Gear_Rider.pdf

Marta Reyes
